_note: The weekly code review's findings for the app and the website (BRIEF_CODE_AUDIT.md). Rows are never deleted; status is open, fixed (with fixed_in) or declined (with Hidde's words). The review reads this first so nothing is reported twice.

findings.summary: A corrected pin, new photo or fixed name reaches the map only after a restart: the redraw compares tree ids only.
findings.fix: Redraw when the drawn fields differ, keeping the same-array fast path.

findings.summary: Own pins compare ids only and the route only its point count.
findings.fix: Compare coordinates, photo presence and route identity.

findings.summary: The account may load twice at cold launch, running two merges at once.
findings.fix: One in-flight load task.

findings.summary: A photo can download twice in one merge.
findings.fix: Download once.

findings.summary: The map style always loads from the web; a cold start without signal may draw no map.
findings.fix: Bundle the style, refresh from the web.
findings.why: MapLibre keeps the style in its own cache and uses it offline after the first load; only a first launch with no signal draws no map, and then no tiles are on the phone either

findings.summary: After sign-in the camera sheet is presented while the sign-in sheet is still closing.
findings.fix: Present after the first sheet has gone.
findings.why: the callback fires from nudge.sheetGone() after the sign-in sheet has gone, the existing chaining pattern

findings.summary: Two share URLs are force-unwrapped from a slug.
findings.fix: Optional URL.

findings.summary: The map list filters and sorts every tree on every pan and drag frame.
findings.fix: Memoise per settled region and filters.

findings.summary: Search rebuilds its city list and ranks twice on every keystroke.
findings.fix: Build once per open, rank once per query.

findings.summary: My trees makes three requests every time the tab appears.
findings.fix: Once per session and on refresh.

findings.summary: Every map repaints about once a second for a season halo that is switched off.
findings.fix: Goes with the Season code being set aside (Hidde, 2026-11-04).

findings.summary: Walks, Season and Plus are dark in the store build but their code still runs.
findings.fix: Set the code aside; it stays in git history.
findings.note: Hidde, 2026-11-04: "set the code aside - we will come back to this but probably completely in a new way"

findings.summary: About a thousand lines nobody reaches: oldBody and its parts, CountryView, CollectionMapPage, PlaceMapPage, dead navigator mailboxes.
findings.fix: Remove, keeping PlaceAmbassadors.

findings.summary: Three Add a photo buttons and a separate Collect route for one act.
findings.fix: One camera action in the bottom bar (Google Maps, iNaturalist).
findings.note: Hidde, 2026-11-04, after the drawing and the honest read that the bar camera is the one photo ask left on screen while scrolling: "leave it as is"

findings.summary: Followers and Following open as a sheet while Find people is a page.
findings.fix: Push them, as Instagram and Strava.

findings.summary: Map filter chips clear each other instead of combining.
findings.fix: Additive chips, an active one reopens its picker (Google Maps, Airbnb).

findings.summary: A city chip on a tree page jumps to the Map tab with no way back.
findings.fix: Push the place map inside the current tab.
findings.note: Hidde, 2026-11-04: "Yes, leave it", after the read that a pushed map in every tab would undo the same day's one-map-screen rule and that the tree page stays under the Discover tab

findings.summary: The tree page's two bottom buttons swap at exactly 200 m and jump with GPS drift.
findings.fix: A band, 150 m in and 250 m out.

findings.summary: The same search result does different things in Discover and on the map.
findings.fix: One rule per result type.
findings.note: Hidde, 2026-11-04: "sluiten", after the read that places already land on the map from both searches and that a tree or species follows the screen it is searched from (the list opens pages, the map shows on the map, as AllTrails does)

findings.summary: Discover's ambassador seat ignores a tap (build 40)
Map pins blink for the first seconds after a fresh install
findings.no_test_reason: A brief visual fade of map symbols in the first seconds after a fresh install; UI tests read the view tree, not rendered map frames. Hidde confirmed it gone on build 41, 2026-11-09.

findings.summary: Discover's ambassador row does nothing when tapped on Hidde's phone on build 41, signed in and signed out; the row shows normally with its arrow. All simulator walks open the sheet (Debug and Release, fake and real test account, moving GPS)
findings.no_test_reason: Only a physical iPhone shows it: thirteen simulator walks, Debug and Release, opened the sheet on the broken code. Confirmed by a logged tap on Hidde's phone before and after the fix.

findings.summary: Android: My trees and the profile page are see-through, the map shows behind the header and the tiles, where the iPhone's sheet turns opaque as it rises
findings.no_test_reason: A colour under a full-height sheet: no unit test sees pixels. The parity page's My trees pair (scripts/android_parity.py, iPhone beside Android) checks it, after the fix that makes the sheet solid as it becomes the page.

findings.summary: Android: Collected tiles in My trees show the drawn placeholder tree instead of the tree's photograph (iOS CollectedTile shows the photo)
findings.no_test_reason: Not a fault in the real code path: the screenshot was the fake -signed-in -mine-demo state, whose demo trees are drawn stand-ins (StandIn). The real path draws the photograph (OursPicture: your newest shot, else ours via RemoteImage); SignedInRoundTrip now signs in on the real test account instead of the fake.

findings.summary: The shared tree's photo URL is built from a server-supplied file name and force-unwrapped, so a name with a space or other unescaped character makes URL(string:) nil and crashes the screen.
findings.fix: Percent-encode the file name and fall back to no photo when URL(string:) is nil.
findings.no_test_reason: Swift cannot be built or run on the Linux night runner; the fix is a flatMap that returns nil on a bad URL, to be exercised by the iOS CI.

findings.note: Hidde, 2026-11-15: "bewaar deze vraag op de backlog voor n later moment". His call which of the two; not a run's.

findings.summary: Android: the keyboard pushed the whole screen up (search field off the top), no windowSoftInputMode
Android: a place from Discover's search opened the map without the tab bar
Android: a photo chosen from the gallery lost its GPS (the system photo picker strips it), so every gallery tree asked where it stands

findings.summary: refreshIfStale treats any non-2xx answer from the token endpoint (a 429 or 5xx blip) as a spent refresh token and removes ancienttrees_session, so a server hiccup signs a signed-in visitor out.
findings.fix: Clear the session only on 400/401/403 (refresh token spent or revoked); on 429, 5xx or a network error leave it in place.

findings.summary: Readers' photographs had no 500 copy: New from visitors tiles and the tree strip loaded the 1600px original and the browser shrank it seven times (soft, shimmering leaves, 750 KB a tile)
